name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Operations Coordinator | Systems Building, Process Documentation & Client Support
summary: Operations professional with 15+ years building and maintaining the internal systems, documentation, and client-facing processes that keep a growing business running. Works independently for a CEO or founder, builds process from scratch rather than inheriting it, and handles sensitive client information with discretion. Financial-operations and HR-administration experience specifically (bookkeeping software, payroll systems) isn't part of the background, worth stating plainly, but the underlying systems-building and process discipline is the same skill this role calls for.
